what: Words where the body's reference listing lisp15.lst (asm7090 2.1.4 + Bourguignon's patch) DISAGREES with the 1962 original listing (LISP1.5-Bonnie-sBirthdayAssembly.pdf in the body). Adjudicated 2026-09-16 by Techne against the PDF pages named, both by the scan's OCR layer (pypdf) and by eye on the rendered page (pdftoppm -r 110). The 1962 listing wins; compare_listing.py accepts the 1962 word at these locations.
render: pdftoppm -f N -l N -r 110 -png <pdf> out  (poppler-utils, in a throwaway container with the body mounted read-only)

also_checked_by_eye.note: REW REWA -- the reference printed 00000 (its cross-header limitation); this world gives 01200 = the 1962 word
RDS RTBA -- unit 01220 for RDS/WRS, 01200 for REW/WEF/BSR: the 1962 listing itself distinguishes them, so 01220 at 00353/00355 in the reference was a 2.1.4 error
